title: OperatingModeScheduleTypeObject
description:
* `SAME_HOURS_DAILY` - Specifies the `operating mode` is active during the same hours daily (i.e., same schedule for Monday to Friday, and Saturday to Sunday).
 * `DIFFERENT_HOURS_DAILY` - Specifies the `operating mode` is active during different hours for different days of the week.
 * `HOLIDAY` - Specifies the `operating mode` is active during holidays with their own days, and recurrence.
 * `NONE` - Specifies the `operating mode` doesn't have any schedules defined.
